annotations.title: Everything DFX knows about one id

description: Everything DFX holds on one id: the card, relationships with sources and dates, recent events, the observations each fact traces to, and identity links to other graphs by shared CRD, CIK or EIN. detail=compact returns key facts and counts under 2 KB. Without a paid plan on a vertical, lists name their first 5 rows and count the rest; each answer states what it withheld.

detail.description: compact: the id, name, type, up to five key facts with their citation and counts of the related rows by type, under 2 KB. research (the default): the full answer.

dfx_id.description: A DFX id of the form dfx:<graph>:<id> (fo, isi, vc, pe, ria, al, pc, ref), or a bare real estate id.

include.description: Default: relationships, events, evidence, same_as. Add name_candidates to also search the other graphs by name (slower; candidates only).

name: get_entity
title: Everything DFX knows about one id
